# Patient RX System v2.0.69

## Security Hardening, FortiGate Support, Role Controls, And Staging Bug Fixes

This release promotes the full tested staging/development history into production: security hardening, FortiGate SSL VPN support, server-side idle sessions, automatic security alerts, granular role controls, dashboard cleanup, Clinics/Pharmacies CRUD fixes, Roles modal fixes, and release packaging hardening.

## What Changed

### Security, Auth, And Proxy

- Browser auth now uses the server-set `HttpOnly` `rxToken` cookie instead of browser-readable full-token storage.
- CSRF protection is enforced for cookie-authenticated unsafe API requests.
- CSP now uses per-request nonces for inline script/style blocks while keeping legacy inline event/style attributes compatible until those are refactored.
- Server-side idle-session validation protects API requests and protected web pages; foreground activity refreshes the session through `/api/session/activity`.
- Automatic security alerts are wired for failed-login thresholds, account lockouts, missing-auth spikes, permission-denied spikes, admin logins, security setting changes, API key changes, backup failures, missing scheduled backups, critical errors, and email configuration failures.
- System Settings rendering paths were hardened to reduce stored-XSS risk from settings/user values.
- SMTP passwords are encrypted at rest when saved through System Settings.
- Document upload UI/routes are removed, and Google Drive document upload API usage is disabled.
- FortiGate proxy handling now supports `Browser HTTPS -> FortiGate -> internal HTTP -> Node app` without redirecting to broken internal HTTPS.
- `.env.example` now documents the safe HTTPS/proxy flags.

### Roles, Dashboard, And Copy/Print/Export Controls

- Roles now include tested controls for screen copy, print, and export behavior.
- Screen copy protection can block copy, cut, selection, context-menu copy, and drag actions for roles where Copy is disabled.
- Server-side role permission defaults/fallbacks now prevent missing Print/Export/Copy flags from breaking admin/read-only login.
- Dashboard export/search controls were removed because the dashboard no longer exposes export/print actions.
- Stale dashboard export behavior no longer produces misleading zero-valued exports.
- The Roles editor modal no longer leaves the page blurred or stacked with extra backdrops after role edits.
- Role matrix/help documentation now explains Print, Export, and Copy behavior.

### Clinics, Pharmacies, And CRUD Forms

- Clinics and Pharmacies optional fields can be cleared back to blank/null; required Name fields remain protected.
- Shared CRUD save handling now sends cleared optional text/select/number fields as `null` instead of omitting them.
- User password edits keep the existing password when the password field is left blank.
- Admin/read-only login and role-permission edge cases were checked after disabling patient Print/Export options.

### Release Packaging

- Release zip packaging was hardened so freshly built `server.exe` can be packaged reliably even when PowerShell `Compress-Archive` cannot read the EXE immediately.

## Database Impact

- No schema changes.
- No destructive data changes.
- Existing patients, RX records, workflow records, audit logs, reports, and settings are preserved.
- SMTP password values are encrypted when saved through System Settings after the update.
- Existing production documents are not expected for this deployment; document upload remains disabled.
- Role permission JSON may now carry `canPrint`, `canExport`, and `canCopy` flags. Missing flags fall back safely for existing roles.

## Production Verification Checklist

After installing the `v2.0.69` update:

1. Confirm the sidebar/version badge or `/api/version` shows `2.0.69`.
2. Open the normal production FortiGate URL and confirm the browser address starts with `https://rx.camperos.net:10443`.
3. Confirm the FortiGate backend/bookmark uses internal protocol `HTTP`, host `192.168.15.87`, and the production app port.
4. Log in and confirm the browser cookie for `rxToken` is `HttpOnly`, `Secure`, and `SameSite=None` when accessed through FortiGate.
5. Confirm there is no redirect to `https://192.168.15.87:<port>`.
6. Add or edit a test patient and save successfully.
7. Open a patient/RX record and confirm document upload controls are not shown.
8. Open System Settings, save a harmless setting, and confirm the page still renders correctly.
9. If SMTP settings are used, send a test email from System Settings.
10. Edit and save a role, then reopen it; confirm the Roles page does not stay blurred and the modal is usable.
11. Confirm a role with copy disabled cannot copy/select app screen data, while allowed roles can.
12. Confirm disabled Print/Export permissions hide or disable those actions where they exist, and admin login still works.
13. Edit a Clinic and a Pharmacy, clear optional fields, save, and confirm the blank fields stay blank while Name remains required.
14. Lower the idle-session timeout in a controlled test and confirm inactive sessions require login again after timeout.
15. Trigger a safe failed-login test with a disposable user and confirm security alert/audit behavior if email alerts are configured.
